description: The signed-in couple's own wedding details on Zola: change the wedding date, the wedding city and state or province, or the estimated number of guests. Give only the values that change. The current values are in zola_get_my_planning_overview. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with each value from and to, and what else the change moves (for a new date: the countdown, the date on the wedding website, the due dates of the checklist, and the wedding season when the month gives another season. For a removed date: the season too, from and to). Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same values and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Status: preview (nothing changed yet), nothing_to_change (the wedding already has these values), done (changed), draft_changed (the wedding details changed on zola.com: show the new preview and ask again). A call with a used confirm_token returns the stored result. The events of the wedding website (ceremony, reception) keep their own dates: zola_list_my_wedding_events shows them. The estimated number of guests is not the guest list. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

city.description: The new wedding city. Leave it out to keep the city

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same wedding_date, wedding_date_undecided, city, state_province and estimated_guest_count

estimated_guest_count.description: The new estimate of the number of guests, 1 to 2000. It is not the guest list

state_province.description: The new state or province, for example NY. Leave it out to keep the state

wedding_date.description: The new wedding date, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later in American Samoa time (Pacific/Pago_Pago, UTC-11), the latest US time zone: Zola refuses an earlier date

wedding_date_undecided.description: true removes the wedding date, when the couple has not decided it. Do not give it with wedding_date

name: zola_update_my_wedding_details

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change of the wedding date, location or estimated guest count of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the wedding details

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_wedding_details with the same wedding_date, wedding_date_undecided, city, state_province and estimated_guest_count, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The wedding details: 1 record with each field that changes that change

records.description: The wedding details: 1 record with each field that changes with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: Always the fixed value wedding: the wedding details are 1 record, and no read gives an id for them

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: 1 when the change overwrites or removes a value that the wedding has

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Update My Wedding Details
